Photography Stories

Explore & Discover

Editorial themes from the DJI range — what these drones are made for.

Canyons from above

Steep walls, long shadows — the kind of frame a folding DJI Mini makes possible on a walk, not a film set.

Desert light

Open ground and low sun. The Air and Mavic range is built for wide, clean aerial frames like this.

Following the action

Fast subjects, smooth tracking — Avata and the Mini range follow the moment instead of missing it.

Over the water

Coastlines and surf from above — aerial photography that turns a familiar beach into something new.

Working from the sky

Agras aircraft work the fields — spraying and surveying across acres from the air.

Enterprise in the field

Matrice platforms for inspection and enterprise work — the professional end of the drone range.
